items.summary: SAP NetWeaver Knowledge Management (XML Forms) does not sufficiently restrict the selection of XSL transformations, letting an authenticated user trigger an unauthorized transformation that can lead to arbitrary code execution in the application context.

SAP NetWeaver misses authorization checks and input validation in remote-enabled functionality, allowing a low-privileged attacker to inject and execute arbitrary code through a remote interface, with high impact on confidentiality, integrity and availability.

An improper authorization flaw in Fortinet FortiManager lets an unauthenticated attacker who can reach the FGFM port execute code or commands via crafted FGFM packets, before the registration password is verified. Fortinet filed the 9.8 base score with NVD.

SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence Platform (Web Intelligence) does not properly restrict external entity resolution when processing OLAP connection requests, letting an authenticated attacker exploit XXE to access sensitive data.
A critical remote code execution vulnerability in PTC Windchill and PTC FlexPLM, exploitable through the deserialization of untrusted data.
